review:
A 5x3 western where scatters only land on reels 2, 3 and 4, and three of them give Raid Spins. The three-row Bounty Hunter wild on those same reels always nudges into full view, and a related Few Dollars More wild builds on it.

Land bonus symbols on reels 1 and 5 in the same row and you get a Mexican Standoff that respins that row. Extreme volatility with a 52,310x max – one of Nolimit's bigger ceilings.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
